value.rationale: The census addresses the first odd boundary case immediately adjacent to a new characteristic-zero theorem, in the excluded characteristic 2. It gives the complete finite-field distribution rather than a sampled example, quantifies the extremal mass as 1792/2159, and separates 840 nontrivial zero spaces from the automatic identity-containing locus.
